title: Configure and document OmniStream custom domain (ommistream.net) on IC mainnet

requirements.text: Add the Internet Computer custom-domain allowlist file to the frontend static assets so the deployed assets canister can serve OmniStream on the custom domain ommistream.net.
acceptanceCriteria: A static file exists at frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains (exact path, no extension).
The file content includes the domain "ommistream.net" on its own line.
The file content includes the domain "www.ommistream.net" on its own line.
After deploying the frontend assets canister to mainnet, fetching https://<FRONTEND_ASSETS_CANISTER_ID>.icp0.io/.well-known/ic-domains returns the expected domain list (via browser or curl).

requirements.text: Update the repo-local mainnet deployment documentation to include a dedicated section for configuring OmniStream to be reachable at the custom domain ommistream.net, including the exact steps a user must perform outside the repo (DNS) and inside the repo (deploying the .well-known/ic-domains asset). Use English for all user-facing text.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/docs/ic-mainnet-deployment.md contains a clearly titled section for custom domain setup (ommistream.net).
The doc explains that the custom domain points to the frontend assets canister (not the backend canister).
The doc describes how to obtain the frontend assets canister ID after deployment and how to form the canister URL using icp0.io.
The doc includes explicit examples of correct hash-routing URLs (e.g., https://ommistream.net/#/ , https://ommistream.net/#/watch/<title>).
The doc includes explicit DNS instructions (record type and target) expressed without assuming a specific registrar UI, and indicates that DNS propagation can take time.
The doc explicitly states that this repo/code change cannot perform the real-world DNS update automatically.

requirements.text: Update the frontend environment configuration example to include the recommended Internet Identity derivation origin setting for the custom domain ommistream.net.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/.env.example includes an uncommented or clearly documented example line showing II_DERIVATION_ORIGIN=https://ommistream.net (or an explicit instruction to set it to that value when using the custom domain).
The added/updated comments explain, in English, that II_DERIVATION_ORIGIN is relevant when using a custom domain so user principals remain consistent across domains.

requirements.text: Improve the backend-unavailable error banner guidance so it mentions both the icp0.io canister URL format and the custom domain ommistream.net as valid access paths, and provides a clear English hint that a misconfigured custom domain can cause access failures.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/components/BackendUnavailableBanner.tsx displays English guidance that includes both (1) the current icp0.io hostname when applicable and (2) a mention of https://ommistream.net as the intended custom domain.
If the current hostname is not an icp0.io domain, the banner text includes a clear suggestion to try the icp0.io canister URL as a fallback and to verify custom-domain configuration.
All user-facing text added/changed is in English.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other paths listed as immutable (compose them instead).
Do not claim to have performed real-world DNS or registrar configuration; only implement repo changes and documentation.
nonGoals: Actually buying the domain ommistream.net or configuring the registrar/DNS provider on the user’s behalf.
Issuing or managing TLS certificates outside what IC boundary nodes provide for supported custom domains.
Changing application features unrelated to custom-domain accessibility (feeds, uploads, watch UI, live sessions).
